card.name: Partway through split-up words
card.fires_on: Responds to the piece of a word that follows a split, such as 'se' after 'per', 'ans' in 'Slogans', 'its' in 'Affidavits', or 'ib' in a drug name. It appears where a rare word is broken into parts.

modes.label: Latin 'per se'
modes.description: The word after 'per' in phrases like 'per se' or 'per say'.
modes.example: rather than social interaction per<< se>>, that led to its activation

modes.label: Rare word endings
modes.description: The ending piece of a rare word or name, including drug names ending in -ib.
modes.example: increase ripretin<<ib>> dose frequency to twice daily

modes.label: Inside a split word
modes.description: A middle piece of a long uncommon word.
modes.example: WARNING: POST TREATMENT ACUTE EXACER<<B>>ATION OF HEPATITIS B
